annotation_status_values.annotated: taste_annotation block complete and specific — ready for taste derivation
annotation_status_values.needs-annotation: structural data complete (status=complete) but taste_annotation not yet written
annotation_status_values.skeleton-only: segment structure exists but many TODO fields remain — not ready for derivation
annotation_status_values.not-started: preprocess-reel.py has not been run yet

reference_strength_values.strong: this reel is a clear positive example — patterns here are worth learning from
reference_strength_values.weak: included for contrast or anti-pattern extraction only — do not use as positive reference
reference_strength_values.unrated: not yet evaluated — do not use for taste derivation

pipeline.step_2_annotate: Open skeleton.json, view frames/, classify each segment (template, visual, caption, proof_class, avatar)
pipeline.step_3_caption_ocr: Manually transcribe captions from keyframes or use OCR if Tesseract is available
pipeline.step_4_taste_annotation: Fill in the taste_annotation block — read training/README-feedback-annotation.md first. Set annotation_completeness and annotation_source.
pipeline.step_5_style_card: If this reel represents a new style, define the style_card with template_registry and rules
pipeline.step_6_validate: Check all TODO fields are filled, all segments have templates, proof_escalation is ordered, taste_annotation is complete
pipeline.step_7_derive: python training/derive_style_pack.py — produces template-registry, rhythm-bounds, caption-modes, taste-rules
